data.one_liner: Modular AST-based GraphQL request execution interface.
data.what_it_does: Provides a composable link interface to build GraphQL execution pipelines. Allows chaining custom behaviors like deduplication and routing before hitting a terminating transport link.
use_when: You need a modular, chainable pipeline for executing GraphQL operations
You are building or extending GraphQL client tooling in Dart/Flutter
avoid_when: You are looking for a high-level all-in-one GraphQL client framework rather than low-level link primitives
Your project relies strictly on simple REST APIs
strengths: Highly modular and composable link-based architecture
Supports custom links via classes, functions, or routers
weaknesses: Requires combining with other packages like http link to fully function
Documentation for advanced usage relies heavily on external links

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer a powerful general-purpose HTTP client over a dedicated GraphQL link execution pipeline.

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a lightweight standard HTTP client without GraphQL-specific execution abstractions.
